title: Too big for the crusier
text: Too big for the crusier. These do not fit the 30 oz cruiser  they slide right over the top. I called customer service and they are trying to fix the problem, but in the mean time they continue to sell this item..  I was able to make it work by putting some silicone one the handle that made it smaller and it worked this way.

product_metadata.title: Simple Modern 30oz Cruiser Tumbler Handle | Reusable, Dishwasher Safe, BPA Free Accessory for Insulated Stainless Steel Travel Cup | Tumbler NOT Included | Cruiser Collection | Midnight Black
features: S|M Compatible: Designed for Simple Modern 30oz Cruiser tumbler, including officially licensed tumblers with NFL, NCAA, NBA, and more. Does NOT fit 22oz or 32oz Slim Cruiser (tumbler sold separately).
Easy to Use: Just slide the bottom of the tumbler into the opening of the tumbler handle and it's ready to use. It's easy to grip, reusable and great for taking on-the-go.
Cupholder Friendly: This tumbler handle was designed to be compatible with most cupholders.
